en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Suleyman Bin Rashid, from his father who said,
‘I saw Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> and upon him<sup>asws</sup> was a black cloak and a blue pallium’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Sulayman ibn Rashid from his father who has said the following: “
I once saw Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, wearing a black outer garment and a blue Taylisan (pallium).’”
